name: settings-group
purpose: A band of a settings page: an h2 with a `Hint` glyph that carries the one-sentence guidance, over the band body (usually a flush `Card` of `SettingsRow` rows). Bands stack at the section gap with no rule between them. An anchored band shows a copy-link button in the gutter when the heading is hovered or focused; a collapsible band turns the heading into a disclosure that unfolds the body along the grid track.
useWhen: Use SettingsGroup for a band of a settings page whose body is SettingsRow rows; any other band heading is a Subheader.
Every settings page and create page: a resource's Settings tab, Account Settings, a create form, a create drawer.
An Advanced band that starts closed (`collapsible`).
avoidWhen: A band whose heading carries a description line and actions → use `subheader`.
A disclosure list of several independent panels → use `accordion`.
related: `settings-row` — the rows inside the band's card.
`card` — the flush (`:padded="false"`) surface the rows sit on.
`hint` — the guidance glyph beside the title.

`subheader` — the band heading with a description and actions. Pick by content: a settings band of `SettingsRow`s (a Hint, a gutter copy-link, an optional disclosure) is `SettingsGroup`; a console band heading with a description and its own actions is `Subheader`; a marketing section heading is `module-header`. The three share the h2 and the copy-link anchor; folding SettingsGroup's heading onto Subheader is a planned refactor, not a behaviour change.
bestPractices: One sentence of guidance in `hint`; the title names the band in one or two words.
Set `anchor` on bands people link to.
Use `collapsible` only for an Advanced band whose defaults are right for most people; it starts closed.
Stack the bands inside one form column (`layout-column-form`); the first band takes no top margin.

props.name: label
props.doc: The group heading, rendered as an h2.

props.name: hint
props.doc: One-sentence guidance shown in a Hint glyph beside the label.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Id of the h2 that a hash link targets; when set, a copy-link button appears in the gutter on hover or focus.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Turns the label into a disclosure that folds the band body.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Glyph shown before the label of a collapsible band (e.g. `az az-settings`).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The band body, usually a flush Card of SettingsRow rows.

slots.name: label
slots.notes: Rich label content; replaces the `label` prop text in the h2.

slots.name: info
slots.notes: An affordance beside the heading, after the `hint` glyph and outside the h2 and the disclosure button: a help button that opens the page's `HelpPanel`. Clicking it never folds the band.
